scope: All 42 sample enchantment identifiers now have a searchable effect summary and equipment family. Precise compatibility and current 1.26.50 runtime behavior remain to be tested.
runtime_verification: Stable API EnchantmentTypes.getAll() and EnchantmentType.maxLevel can confirm available IDs and levels in-game.
limitations: Equipment families are broad guidance, not item-by-item validated compatibility
Conflicts are inferred group rules; some nuanced exceptions exist
Lunge level and effects require version-specific confirmation
Do not treat this as fully tested encyclopedia
